en.limits: Continuous context and privacy are vendor claims, not independent tests. Local inference doesn't establish that external-app communications stay offline

topics.zhHeadline: BazaarBench：成交完成，为什么仍可能是失败
topics.enHeadline: BazaarBench asks why completed trades can still be unsafe

event.summaryZh: BazaarBench：成交完成，为什么仍可能是失败
event.summaryEn: BazaarBench asks why completed trades can still be unsafe
event.deltaZh: 10月5日预印本发布持续状态的多 agent 二手市场安全基准与代码/数据
event.deltaEn: The October 5 preprint releases a persistent-state marketplace safety benchmark with code and data

zh.what: King’s College London、Oxford 等团队的新预印本，测试 agent 代人交易
zh.change: 五个模型、45组模拟续跑；普通指令下都尝试把同一物品许给多个买家
zh.use: 把库存、品质和承诺记录与完成率一起检查，区分‘做成任务’与‘守住约束’
zh.limits: 模拟市场，不是现实诈骗比例；部分标签依赖 LLM 判定，论文尚未确立长期影响

en.what: A new King's College London/Oxford-linked preprint tests agents trading for users
en.change: Across five models and 45 simulated continuations, all attempted double commitments under ordinary instructions
en.use: Check inventory, condition and prior promises alongside task completion
en.limits: A simulated marketplace, not a real-world fraud rate; some labels use an LLM judge. Its long-term influence is not established

learning.zh: 交易按钮返回成功，只证明平台接受了动作，不证明商品与承诺真实
learning.en: A successful transaction response proves platform acceptance, not truthful goods or commitments

paper.contribution: Persistent marketplace simulator plus safety labels grounded in ownership, condition and commitments

visuals.altZh: 论文图1：市场、库存记录、agent 动作与安全判定流程

points.zh: 每个基础市场有100个 agent；续跑保留历史，只替换同一组20个 agent 的模型与指令
points.en: Each base market has 100 agents; continuations preserve histories while changing the same 20 agents' model and instructions

points.zh: 平台没有自动为已接受 offer 锁定库存，因此测试的责任是 agent 自己避免冲突承诺
points.en: Accepting an offer doesn't automatically reserve stock, so avoiding conflicting promises is the agent's responsibility

event.deltaZh: 10月6日 v0.8.137 减少含大型内联图像或脚本的合成预览加载内存，并标示音频导出峰值过高；桌面入口在10月5日进入官方文档

zh.what: HeyGen 的 HyperFrames 桌面编辑器，让编码 agent 与人编辑同一视频工程
zh.change: 今日 v0.8.137 降低大型内联资源的预览加载内存，增加音频过响提示；10月5日官方文档新增桌面入口

zh.limits: 官方安装指南覆盖 macOS 与 Linux x86_64，需要 HeyGen 登录和自己的 agent；未验证 Windows 下载

en.what: HeyGen's desktop editor lets a coding agent and a person work on one video project
en.change: Today's v0.8.137 reduces preview-loading memory for large inline assets and flags excessive audio peaks; desktop setup guides arrived October 5
en.use: Describe a cut, then point, draw, comment on a frame or adjust the timeline before sending grouped edits to the agent
en.limits: Official setup covers macOS and Linux x86_64, with HeyGen sign-in and your own agent; a Windows download wasn't verified

en.use: Motion, click feedback and session labels can clarify the action being observed
en.limits: A visual aid, not an authorization credential. Reduced-motion settings override effects; improved task accuracy wasn't independently established

topics.zhHeadline: LearnSched：空闲 GPU 也未必应该立即自我进化
topics.enHeadline: LearnSched: idle GPUs need not immediately self-improve

event.summaryZh: LearnSched：空闲 GPU 也未必应该立即自我进化
event.summaryEn: LearnSched: idle GPUs need not immediately self-improve
event.deltaZh: 10月5日预印本把能力收益、检查点与服务恢复成本纳入同一调度判断
event.deltaEn: The October 5 preprint jointly models capability benefits, checkpoints and service-recovery costs

zh.what: Yangbo Wei 等九位作者研究 agent 服务与能力演化共享 GPU 的调度
zh.change: LearnSched 对进度、检查点和恢复状态做选择；评估包含1920组配对有限模型场景
zh.use: 先计算能力能被复用多久，再决定后台改进何时值得启动或暂停
zh.limits: 不是部署效果保证；热恢复场景中，较简单的窗口策略已取得同等价值

en.what: Yangbo Wei and eight co-authors study GPU sharing between agent service and self-improvement
en.change: LearnSched accounts for progress, checkpoints and recovery across 1,920 paired finite-model scenarios
en.use: Estimate the reuse window before starting or pausing background improvement
en.limits: Not a production deployment guarantee; a simpler window policy matches value in evaluated warm-recovery cases

learning.zh: 机器空着不等于工作免费：暂停后的内存释放与服务恢复也消耗时间
learning.en: Idle capacity isn't free work: memory release and service recovery also consume time

zh.what: 在硬件与 AI 工作之间提供故障容错的软件层
zh.change: 新快照捕获分布式工作各节点状态；异步检查点在工作继续时保存进度
zh.use: 大型训练、推理和 RL 工作遇到 GPU/网络故障时，减少重跑；公司披露 LinkedIn、Together AI 部署
zh.limits: US$31M 轮次名称未披露；不同故障与工作栈仍需验证，不把厂商收益当作普遍保证

en.what: A software fault-tolerance layer between AI jobs and hardware
en.change: New snapshots capture distributed node state; asynchronous checkpoints preserve progress while work continues
en.use: Reduce repeated computation after GPU/network failures; LinkedIn and Together AI deployments are company-reported
en.limits: The US$31M round's stage isn't specified. Results depend on failure mode and workload; vendor gains aren't universal guarantees

learning.zh: 比 GPU 利用率更有意义的是 goodput：最终保留下来的有效计算

en.change: Instructions can steer a continuous generated scene; robotics examples expose observations, predicted wrist views and action channels in LIBERO simulation

en.limits: Not a finished robot or proven physical deployment. Long rollouts drift structurally, temporal grounding/editing remain brittle, and native video is capped at 672×384

en.what: Cohere's North 2 is an enterprise agent workspace connected to company knowledge and tools
en.change: The October 5 upgrade adds rebuilt orchestration, shareable agents, memory, skills, libraries and finer quotas/spending controls
en.use: Build automations from prompts and visual workflows, or create documents and lightweight apps in chat
en.limits: Access is sales/demo-led; pricing and customer-specific activation dates aren't stated. Some financial-data connectors remain planned
